summary: The repair is confirmed on the exact recorded candidate. Focused (4/4) and full controller (55/55) TAP pass. The unchanged R1403 adversarial script now retains the newer draft after a held registration fails following navigation away/back, while preserving committed-success projection, approved aliases after known and unknown failures, and foreign/captured profile authority. A real fixture persistence failure induced by Storage.setItem throwing only at registration returns storage_unavailable, retains the form draft and school/terms, and leaves no account/session/storage value or credential trace.

results.command: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern='registration transport failure retains|registration unknown outcome retains|registration retains the current draft after navigation away and back|failed re-registration preserves' vendor/hh/src/public-controller.test.mjs

actual_fixture_storage_failure.method: Storage.setItem throws only after lookups and form preparation, at the registration persist boundary; no failWith injection or fabricated runtime result.

evidence.credential_handling: Ephemeral credentials were generated at runtime and checked only for absence in serialized surfaces. No credential values were printed or saved in evidence.

limits: The approved-alias check is a direct public-controller dispatch regression; the rendered approved registration route presents an approval panel, not a visible re-registration form. This is not a claim of UI re-registration coverage.
Evidence is fixture-provider/controller/render-tree only, not mounted-browser visual QA.
Repository source and Git state remained read-only; all H2 writes are confined to hh-cycle10/H2/R1405.
